name: Aegis Assault

values.label: Cone radius, truncated in the back so it cannot hit behind Pantheon

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Pantheon braces his shield in the target direction and channels for 1.5 seconds, during which he becomes invulnerable to non-turret damage dealt by enemies from the target direction. He also continually performs strikes in a cone in front of him, dealing 8.3% AD physical damage every 0.125 seconds to enemies hit, reduced by 50% against minions and up to 100% AD total physical damage.

notes: Deals persistent area damage for the continuous strikes and area damage with the slam.

The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse passive.

name: Aegis Protection

parts.label: Innate
parts.text: Innate: Pantheon gains a stack of Aegis Protection when he lands a basic attack or casts an ability, up to a maximum of 4. Upon reaching 4 stacks, he consumes all stacks and gains Aegis Protection.

parts.label: Aegis Protection
parts.text: Aegis Protection: Pantheon blocks the next incoming basic attack from an enemy champion, large monster, or the next incoming shot from a turret.
Stacks of Aegis Protection cannot be gained during the blocking, also he cannot gain 2 Aegis Protection at the same time.

notes: Aegis Protection consistently negates all on-hit effects attached to basic attacks, with a few exceptions (Harsh Lesson, Devastating Charge).
Aegis Protection will also block abilities that can trigger on-hit effects (Parrrley, Mystic Shot)

name: Mortal Will

parts.label: Innate
parts.text: Innate: Pantheon generates a stack of Mortal Will whenever he lands a basic attack on-hit or casts an ability, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, Pantheon's next basic ability consumes the stacks to become empowered with an additional effect.

mechanics.evidence: Innate: Pantheon generates a stack of Mortal Will whenever he lands a basic attack on-hit or casts an ability, stacking up to 5 times.

parts.text: Pantheon gains maximum stacks of Mortal Will upon starting the game, completing a Recall channel, and respawning.

notes: The current number of Mortal Will stacks is represented by a counter under Pantheon's health bar, visible to all players. It will light up when he reaches maximum stacks and the empowered effect is ready.

Comet Spear's total damage is reduced to 80% against monsters and to 70% against minions.

notes: Applies spell damage on the initial vault. Deals basic damage on all the attacks from the empowered ability.
Pantheon will be ordered to basic attack the target at the end of the leap.

The empowered attack rolls a critical strike once for all strikes; either all will critically strike, or none will. If Sundered Sky Lightshield Strike is ready, all three strikes will critically strike.

Despite the multi-hit attack only having a hidden cast time, Pantheon will remain unable to act until the last strike has been dealt.
  - The empowered attack's total time is affected by Pantheon's attack speed.
  - The attack's total time is the cast time plus Pantheon's attack windup time.
The 3 strikes that occur after Empowered Shield Vault each count as a separate cast instance for effects such as Electrocute and Eclipse Ever Rising Moon.
The 3 strikes that occur after Empowered Shield Vault each apply a stack of Mortal Will, even if the attacks are dodged, blocked, or missed while Pantheon is blinded.
The empowered attack will not trigger against structures.

The empowered attack does not cause Pantheon to attack thrice. Effects that trigger on-attack or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with Shield Vault. (e.g. Lethal Tempo, Hail of Blades).
